items.title: Summer 2027 SWE internships open to sophomores
items.summary: Several large tech companies run first- and second-year internship tracks that open in the fall. Applying early matters more than a perfect resume.
items.nextStep: Pick 2 sophomore-friendly programmes and paste the links into Northstar to fill.

items.title: Free drop-in tutoring for CS61B
items.summary: The EECS honor society runs free drop-in tutoring for lower-division CS courses on weekday afternoons, which lines up with your best focus hours.
items.whyLead: This could make Project 3 feel smaller
items.nextStep: Bring one Project 3 question to a drop-in session this week.

items.title: Scholarships for students in robotics clubs
items.summary: Some engineering scholarships favour students with hands-on robotics team experience. Most ask for a short essay and one reference.
items.whyLead: Your club work could help pay for school
items.nextStep: Search the scholarship list for 'robotics' and save one that fits.

items.title: 10-minute prep for the internship fair
items.summary: A short pitch and three target companies is enough to make a career fair useful. Recruiters remember a specific question more than a resume.
items.nextStep: Write a 3-sentence intro: year, what you build in Cal Robotics, what role you want.

items.title: How online coding assessments are scored
items.summary: Most online assessments are two timed problems where partial credit counts. One timed practice run beforehand is the highest-value prep.
items.nextStep: Do one 25-minute timed practice problem during your 2-5pm focus window.
